name: Expected Execution Details 5
definition: Expected trade date and expected settlement date of the order execution.

ExpectedTradeDateTime.name: Expected Trade Date Time
ExpectedTradeDateTime.definition: Expected date or expected date and time at which a price will be applied according to the terms of the prospectus.

ExpectedCashSettlementDate.name: Expected Cash Settlement Date
ExpectedCashSettlementDate.definition: Date of a payment, for example, a prepayment date.

DateElementRule.definition: Either ExpectedTradeDateTime or ExpectedCashSettlementDate must be present. Both may be present.
